checks.name: ck_device_intent_identity
checks.clause: ((`contract_version` = 1) and (`device_pk` > 0) and (`device_epoch` > 0) and (`target_pk` > 0) and regexp_like(`operation_id`,_ascii'^[0-9a-f]{32}$',_utf8mb4'c') and regexp_like(`device_code`,_ascii'^[0-9]{20}$',_utf8mb4'c') and regexp_like(`target_code`,_ascii'^[0-9]{20}$',_utf8mb4'c') and ((`target_scope` = _ascii'channel') or ((`target_scope` = _ascii'device') and (`target_pk` = `device_pk`) and (`target_code` = `device_code`))) and (`kind` in (_ascii'live',_ascii'playback',_ascii'download',_ascii'talk',_ascii'ptz')))

checks.name: ck_device_intent_phase
checks.clause: ((`updated_at` >= `created_at`) and (((`state` = _ascii'reserved') and (`row_version` = 1) and (`dispatch_started_at` is null) and (`cancelled_at` is null)) or ((`state` = _ascii'dispatched') and (`row_version` >= 2) and (`cancelled_at` is null) and (`dispatch_started_at` is not null) and (`dispatch_started_at` >= `created_at`) and (`dispatch_started_at` <= `updated_at`)) or ((`state` = _ascii'cancelled') and (`row_version` >= 2) and (`dispatch_started_at` is null) and (`cancelled_at` is not null) and (`cancelled_at` >= `created_at`) and (`cancelled_at` <= `updated_at`))))

checks.name: ck_openapi_grant_binding
checks.clause: ((`state` not in (_utf8mb4'issued',_utf8mb4'bound')) or ((`device_id` is not null) and (`channel_id` is not null) and (`node_uuid` is not null) and (`boot_nonce` is not null) and (char_length(`boot_nonce`) = 32) and (`schema` is not null) and (`device_id` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`channel_id` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`node_uuid` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`boot_nonce` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`schema` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`vhost` is not null) and (`vhost` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`app` is not null) and (`app` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`stream` is not null) and (`stream` <> _utf8mb4'') and (`media_generation` is not null) and (`media_generation` > 0) and (`protocol` is not null) and (`protocol` <> _utf8mb4'')))

checks.name: ck_ptz_attempt_retirement
checks.clause: (((`retired_by_process_id` is null) and (`retired_at` is null)) or ((`retired_by_process_id` is not null) and (`retired_at` is not null) and (`owner_process_id` is not null) and (`owner_run_id` is not null) and (`retired_by_process_id` <> `owner_process_id`) and (`local_quiesced_at` is null)))
